educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn about general terms of sequences and their limits. (2) Learn about series (3) Learn about the differential coefficients and derivatives. (4) Learn about function graphs. (5) Learn about indefinite and definite integrals of functions.
advice: This is a basic course of calculus. We will cover the following materials. 1. Sequence and Limit 1.1 Sequence and Limit 1.2 Sum of Sequences 1.3 Series 2. Differentiation 2.1 Limit of Functions 2.2 Differential Coefficients and Derivatives 2.3 Derivative Formulas 2.4 Differentiation of Composite Functions 2.5 Function Increase and Decrease and Extreme Values 3. Integration 3.1 Indefinite Integration 3.2 Definite Integration Classes include exercises and quizzes, and a final examination at the end of the semester. Daily preparation and review are important. Students are required to solve designated tasks. Students should study reports and research topics in a planned manner, and strictly avoid plagiarism. Students should actively use the teachers' office hours and the Math. and Science Education Research Center.
books: Textbooks: Mathematics for Information Science A (Calculus) [kanazawa Institute of Technology] Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics (Formula calculation, exponential/ logarithmic/trigonometric functions, etc.) Basic Excel skills.

Be able to find the derivative of basic functions.
Be able to draw the outline of function graphs.
Be able to find the indefinite and definite integral of basic functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for mathematics.
Try to understand the contents, and be able to complete the tasks within the deadlines.
